items.claim: Billy Ray Goff displays good patience and pacing despite his youth and experience level.
items.quote: he knows when to be patient and when to step on the gas, which you don't really see from, you know, younger guys with not a lot of experience.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff's career has been hindered by a lot of canceled fights.
items.quote: there's just a lot of canceled fights here.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff has poor striking defense.
items.quote: his striking defense leaves a lot to be desired.

items.claim: Ty Miller has educated hands, a great jab, and utilizes his height and length well.
items.quote: Tai's got really really educated hands. Uh he's got a great jab. He uses his length and his height very well.

items.claim: Ty Miller effectively goes to the body with his strikes.
items.quote: What I love I love that he goes to the body as well.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff has been hurt by body shots in past fights.
items.quote: he's been hurt to the body before.
